chunks: 1778 - And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has entrusted angels with supplicating for those who fast. And he said: Jibrīl عليه السلام informed me from his Lord, exalted is His mention, that He said:”
“I have not commanded My angels to supplicate for any one of My creation except that I answered them concerning him.”

key_terms.بِالدُّعَاءِ: with supplication on behalf of others
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrīl عليه السلام, the angel conveying revelation
key_terms.مَلَائِكَةً: angels entrusted with a divine task

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the angels praying for those who fast?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, appoints angels to make du'a for those who fast. It emphasizes the virtue of fasting and the special divine response granted when the angels supplicate for a servant.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1778 - The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has appointed angels to supplicate for those who fast. And Archangel Jibril (as) informed me from his Lord (azj), exalted is His mention, that He said:
'Whenever I command My angels to supplicate for any of My creation, I surely answer their supplication for them.'”
